scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:local && concurrently -k -n worker,web "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.toml --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.private.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.private.toml
scripts.deploy:public: npm run typecheck && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run db:local && npm run dev:worker
